title: Rotate an API key
fact: Open Settings > API keys, click Rotate next to the key and copy the new value. The old key stops working immediately.

title: Negative balance
fact: Requests are rejected while the balance is negative. Any top-up or plan purchase clears the debt first. Debts of $1.00 or less can be waived by support once.

title: Pending payments
fact: An order stays pending until the payment provider confirms it, usually within 10 minutes. A pending order older than one hour was most likely not paid; the customer can retry from the Orders page.

title: Refund policy
fact: Unused credit can be refunded on request from the Billing page within 14 days of purchase. Plans are not refundable once activated. Support cannot approve refunds in a ticket.

title: Payment provider delays
fact: Card payments were confirmed with delays of up to 30 minutes on this day.
